rationale: Repair the existing generic waiting-period certification fixture so its EvidenceResolverOutput carries deterministic resolution trace events derived from already-verified evidence-package lineage. The generic certification runner already inherits evidence resolution trace IDs into RuleCertificationResult; no new certification, publication, insurer, or topic authority is introduced.
authority_impact: No authority expansion. Waiting-period certification remains internal and bound_not_published; the repair only preserves auditable lineage already present in verified evidence packages so downstream publication governance can evaluate the existing certification without synthetic trace injection.
